name: Valheim Arsenal
description: Valheim's weapons in Minecraft: clubs, sledges, swords, knives, axes, battleaxes, spears, atgeirs, claws, bows, crossbows, staves and shields, with Valheim's secondary attacks, backstabs, combos, parries, staggers and elemental damage. Original pixel art in the vanilla style. Fan-made; not affiliated with Iron Gate or Mojang.
